newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Basis levels mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Basis levels mixed.

text.p: Basis levels for dark northern spring wheat were mixed Friday, reflecting regional supply and demand considerations, U.S. grain dealers said.
Dealers in Minneapolis and eastern North Dakota reported that basis levels weakened as a result of a slight increase in farm-related selling.

"Basis is really beginning to get soft. The 15 percent (proteins) are really getting pounded. That has to do with the fact that a lot of fifteens are coming to market each day and we're running out of homes for them," a Minneapolis grain dealer said.
But dealers in Montana and in the Pacific Northwest said basis levels were mostly unchanged in response to slack movement.
MGE spring wheat futures closed mixed in mostly light-volume dealings.
